result.reason: The redline reaches the stated fallback by adding only SFJ-level E&O and cyber/privacy coverage at USD 1 million and USD 2 million, respectively. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits CGL, workers' compensation, and certificate requirements and uses lower E&O and cyber limits. The drafting otherwise leaves the existing insurance terms intact and introduces no evident contradiction.
